mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work_activity (workspace_id, entity_type, entity_id, actor_id, actor_name, action, detail) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{entityType}, #{entityId}, #{actorId}, #{actorName}, #{action}, #{detail})
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.entity_id AS docId, d.title AS docTitle, d.req_id AS reqId, d.owner_user_id AS ownerUserId, d.published_at AS publishedAt, a.actor_name AS actorName, a.action, a.detail, a.created_at FROM work_activity a LEFT JOIN requirement_doc d ON d.id = a.entity_id AND d.workspace_id = a.workspace_id WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND a.entity_type = #{entityType} ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM work_activity WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND entity_type = #{entityType} AND entity_id = #{entityId}
